# Quantum Realty Advisors, Inc.

> > Specialized real estate advisory firm providing estate, trust, charitable, and commercial property solutions with CPRES certification and institutional REO management expertise.

Quantum Realty Advisors serves high-net-worth individuals, executors, nonprofits, and institutional clients across South Florida and beyond. The firm specializes in complex real estate transactions including probate properties, charitable donations, and asset management for major financial institutions.

## Key Topics

- Estate & Trust Real Estate
- Probate Specialist (CPRES)
- Charitable Gifts of Real Estate
- REO Asset Management
- Commercial Real Estate Advisory
- Luxury Homes
- Property Valuation
- Trust Property Sales
- Corporate Real Estate Services
- Freddie Mac & Institutional Clients
- Palm Beach Gardens, Florida
- Family Business Real Estate
- Real Estate Brokerage
- Property Management

## Core Services

- [Services](https://quantumrealtyadvisors.com/services): Overview of Quantum Realty Advisors' full service offerings including estate, luxury, and REO services.
- [Estate & Trust Real Estate](https://quantumrealtyadvisors.com/estate-and-trust): Detailed estate and trust real estate services with CPRES certification and executor support.
- [Charitable Gifts of Real Estate](https://quantumrealtyadvisors.com/charitable-gifts): Charitable real estate donation services with tax benefits and nonprofit fundraising guidance.
- [Investment Advisory](https://quantumrealtyadvisors.com/advisory): Investment advisory for commercial real estate, property acquisition, and portfolio repositioning.
- [REO Asset Management](https://quantumrealtyadvisors.com/reo): REO asset management for institutional clients including Freddie Mac and major financial institutions.
- [Corporate & Business Real Estate](https://quantumrealtyadvisors.com/business-real-estate): Corporate and business real estate services in South Florida including office leasing and site selection.
